context: A teacher discusses cultural history research
purpose: Teach: 冬季/転換期/引き揚げ/大出/炎上/踏み切っ/杏/撒き

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、北国の、本気で、絶対、冬季、絶対、生活、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, the way you handled postwar northern rural winter life in your paper — it was genuinely impressive.
lines.style: Warm, measured appreciation. Steady eye contact. Slight pause before naming the topic, giving weight to the recognition. Clear, encouraging tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。戦後の、本気で、絶対、転換期、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I tried to really dig into the postwar transition period — I'm grateful for your guidance on the depth of the research.
lines.style: Humble but sincere. Not self-effacing, just honest. Respectful rhythm. Leans slightly forward with genuine gratitude, not performance.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦後の、本気で、絶対、引き揚げ、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: And the way you examined postwar repatriation — your perspective was remarkably broad. Really first-rate work.
lines.style: Thoughtful, deliberate pace. Genuine admiration without flattery. A slight nod of recognition. Steady voice, no rush.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学園紛争の、本気で、絶対、大出来事、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I wanted to explore the student movement as a major turning point — I'm really thankful you helped me go deeper with it.
lines.style: Respectful, focused. Not rushed. Slight emphasis on the scope of the topic. Sincere gratitude, understated. Small, genuine smile beneath the words.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 当時の、本気で、絶対、社会の炎上、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you captured the social upheaval of that era in your paper — that took real insight.
lines.style: Engaged and present. Slight lean in. Recognition of difficulty and achievement. Steady, warm tone. Not overpraising, just honest.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。国が、本気で、絶対、戦後、絶対、独立に、絶対、踏み切った、絶対、過程、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I focused on the process of how the nation moved toward independence in the postwar period — I'm genuinely grateful for your mentorship on such demanding material.
lines.style: Earnest and clear. Maintains composure but with real warmth underneath. Respectful pacing. The gratitude is genuine, not formal.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時の、本気で、絶対、杏、絶対、を含む、絶対、果樹園経済、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your treatment of wartime orchard economies, including the apricot cultivation — that was quite thorough work.
lines.style: Reflective, appreciative. Slower, careful delivery. Recognition of the specificity and depth. Warm but composed. Slight pause before the detail shows its intentionality.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦後の、本気で、絶対、種撒き、絶対、活動、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I explored postwar agricultural recovery efforts — really, I'm very grateful for your support in developing such rigorous research.
lines.style: Respectful, warm close. Slight softness on the gratitude. Not rushed. The sense of a valued conversation ending with genuine thanks. Small, settling breath.
